body.name: Imported lossless unit-symmetrization and orbit-game equality
body.construction: Import \texttt{thm:exact-response-type-game} from the accepted parent \texttt{exp\_multiarm\_secondorder\_minimax\_frontier}: averaging any outcome-independent labeled design and estimator over common unit permutations is lossless; the resulting design is a count law \(\pi\in\Delta(\mathcal R_{n,3})\) followed, conditional on \(r\), by the uniform fixed-count assignment experiment; and the unrestricted labeled-schedule minimax value equals the finite response-type orbit game.
